address.description: Address is the IP address of the instance

app_id.description:
AppID is the ID of the application the instance is created from. Empty if the
instance has not been created from an application.

app_name.description:
AppName is the name of the application the instance is created from. Empty if the
instance has not been created from an application.

app_version.description:
AppVersion is the version of the application the instance is created from. Empty if the
instance has not been created from an application.

architecture.description: Architecture describes the CPU archtitecture the instance is using

base.description: If this is a base instance or not

config.description: Config summarizes the configuration the instance uses

boot_activity.description: BootActivity specifies the Android activity which is started by default

boot_package.description: BootPackage specifies the Android application package name which is started by default

devmode.description: DevMode specifies if development mode has been turned on for the instance

disable_watchdog.description: DisableWatchdog defines whether the watchdog is disabled

density.description: Density is the piel density of the virtual display

fps.description: FPS is the frame rate of the virtual display

height.description: Height is the height of the virtual display

width.description: Width is the width of the virtual display

enable_streaming.description: EnableStreaming specifies if streaming should be enabled for the instance or not

metrics_server.description: MetricsServer specifies a metrics server the instance will use

platform.description: Platform specifies the Anbox platform the instance is running with

created_at.description: CreatedAt specifies the time at which the instance was created

error_message.description: ErrorMessage provides an error message when the instance status is set to error.

image_id.description:
ImageID is the ID of the image the instance is created from. Empty if the
instance has not been created from an image.

image_version.description:
ImageVersion is the version of the image the instance is created from. Empty if the
instance has not been created from an image.

name.description: Name of the instance. Typically in the format "ams-<ID>".

node.description: Node the instance is running on

public_address.description:
PublicAddress is the external IP address the instance is accessible on (in most
cases the IP of the node it is running on)

status_message.description: StatusMessage describes the current status of the instance

stored_logs.description: StoredLogs lists log files AMS stores for the instance.

tags.description: Tags specifies the tags the instance has assigned

InstanceResources.description: InstanceResources represents resources assigned to an instance

cpus.description: CPUs cores assigned to the instance

disk-size.description: DiskSize specifies the amount of storage assigned to the instance in bytes

gpu-slots.description: GPUSlots specifies the number of GPU slots the instance got allocated

memory.description: Memory assigned to the instance in bytes

vpu-slots.description: VPUSlots specifies the number of VPU slots the instance

InstanceService.description:
While NetworkServiceSpec defines what the user requests, InstanceService is what is actually
opened on the instance.
InstanceService.title: InstanceService describes a single service the instance exposes to the outside world.

expose.description:
Expose defines wether the service is exposed on the public endpoint of the node
or if it is only available on the private endpoint. To expose the service set to
true and to false otherwise.

name.description:
Name gives the instance a hint what the exposed port is being used for. This
allows further tweaks inside the instance to expose the service correctly.

node_port.description:
NodePort is the port used on the LXD node to map to the service port
If left empty the node port is automatically selected.

node_port_end.description:
NodePortEnd, if specified, denotes the end of the port range on the node starting
at NodePort

port.description: Port is the port the instance provides a service on

port_end.description: PortEnd, if specified, denotes the end of the port range starting at Port

protocols.description: List of network protocols (tcp, udp) the port should be exposed for

InstanceStatus.description: InstanceStatus represents the status a instance can be in

InstanceType.description: InstanceType describes the type of an instance (container, vm)

NetworkProtocol.description: NetworkProtocol describes a specific network protocol like TCP or UDP a ContainerService can use
